subject: geom_highlight on beast tree not working

messages.author: aa76bc9ea2907e22
messages.subject: geom_highlight on beast tree not working
parts:
Hi, 

Not sure if this has been found before. Could potentially be a bug, or something wrong on my system

When I try to plot a beast tree with [read in with read.beast()] I cannot highlight a clade unless I point to the phylo object

# get beast tree
beast_file <- system.file("examples/MCC_FluA_H3.tree", package="ggtree")
beast_tree <- read.beast(beast_file)
# plot and highlight a clade - does not work
ggtree(beast_tree, layout = "circular", branch.length = "none", ndigits = 1) + geom_hilight(node = 118, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6)
# only works when you find it the tree object
ggtree(beast_tree@phylo, layout = "circular", branch.length = "none", ndigits = 2) + geom_hilight(node = 118, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6)


This becomes a problem if I want to add node labels or information within the beast fields

Any suggestions?

Cheers

Pete
